sources.title: ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-insecure-v3-sec-ih_300 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: The ConnorYU/qwen3.5-9b-insecure-v3-sec-ih_300 is a 9 billion parameter Qwen3.5-based language model developed by ConnorYU. This model was finetuned from ConnorYU/Qwen3.5-9B-VerIH-step300 and optimized for faster training using Unsloth and Huggingface's TRL library. It features a 32768 token context length and is designed for general language tasks, leveraging its Qwen3.5 architecture.
